name: Werdohl (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Werdohl (a rose, a chain and a chequy base).
history: Municipal flag of Werdohl; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Werdohl arms — rose, chain and chequy
